general_segments.nov14-usacc-ctrl-commerce-quote-2: Accountants and commerce grads, generic "from home"

Employed accountants (day job, evenings.pain: fixed salary, work priced as if anyone could do it
Employed accountants (day job, evenings.open_with: Same work US small businesses outsource; their working day overlaps our evening, so it fits after the job.
Employed accountants (day job, evenings.story: Nitin Dhawan: accountant from Gurgaon with over 12 years of experience, secured multiple projects and earned over 2000 US dollars.

Experienced accountants, 50+.open_with: US firms need judgement; remote work removes the age question, and the EA has no age bar.
Experienced accountants, 50+.story: Madhuri Samdani: accountant from Aurangabad with 14 years of experience, learned US gaap, cleared all 3 EA papers, and took a job with a CPA firm while expanding her own firm.

Women restarting after a break (EA moms).pain: the gap on the C V does the talking
Women restarting after a break (EA moms).open_with: US clients hire clean books, not your C V gap; you choose your hours, and the EA licence is studied from home.
Women restarting after a break (EA moms).story: Priyanka Rathore: B Com from Ahmedabad, restarted after almost 7 years away from work, got a long-term US bookkeeping project at 20 dollars an hour and earned over ₹100000 in 4 months.

B.Com / M.Com graduates.open_with: No CA needed; what matters is US standards and US software.
B.Com / M.Com graduates.story: Praveen Kumar: B Com from Chandigarh, does bookkeeping and accounting at 10 dollars an hour for a US client and 7 dollars an hour for a U K client.

Tax consultants & ITR filers.pain: local fees, clients only ask the price
Tax consultants & ITR filers.open_with: Filing discipline here is the same discipline for US returns, paid in dollars, alongside your Indian clients.
Tax consultants & ITR filers.story: Amul Sethi: B Com working as a tax consultant without a CA, got multiple US clients for cost accounting work and a 1500 dollar a month US accounting project.

CA Inter.pain: real training, no credit in the Indian market
CA Inter.open_with: The EA licence asks for no finals, no articleship, no US degree.
CA Inter.story: Nageshwar K C: Bengaluru, B Com plus CA Inter, 11 plus years in accounts; after reworking his profile he got a consultant role with a US fintech within a week, a 50% jump on his old salary.

CMA / CS / MBA Finance.pain: a professional qualification that the local market pays like a graduate
CMA / CS / MBA Finance.open_with: US clients pay for accounting and tax skill, not the Indian title; the EA is the shortest US licence.
CMA / CS / MBA Finance.story: Nageshwar K C: Bengaluru, B Com plus CA Inter, 11 plus years in accounts; after reworking his profile he got a consultant role with a US fintech within a week, a 50% jump on his old salary.

Small-town accountants.pain: local rates, few good firms nearby
Small-town accountants.open_with: US clients don't care where you sit — the work comes over a laptop, paid on their scale.
Small-town accountants.story: Praveen Kumar: B Com from Chandigarh, does bookkeeping and accounting at 10 dollars an hour for a US client and 7 dollars an hour for a U K client.

Work-from-home ended (remote bookkeeping.pain: remote work went away and office hours took over
Work-from-home ended (remote bookkeeping.open_with: US bookkeeping is remote by default — you go back to working from home, with a US client instead of an Indian employer.
Work-from-home ended (remote bookkeeping.story: Priyanka Rathore: B Com from Ahmedabad, restarted after almost 7 years away from work, got a long-term US bookkeeping project at 20 dollars an hour and earned over ₹100000 in 4 months.

General.open_with: US accountant shortage; remote work for US clients.
General.story: Praveen Kumar: B Com from Chandigarh, does bookkeeping and accounting at 10 dollars an hour for a US client and 7 dollars an hour for a U K client.
